title: MobiSense CityVision
category: Team project · Smart India Hackathon 2026 · Backend & Database Developer
summary: I designed the MySQL 8.0 database and built the FastAPI backend. Detections from YOLOv8 scripts (potholes, garbage, traffic density, accidents) are ingested, de-duplicated by location, and shown on a live city dashboard.
highlights: Spatial de-duplication engine using ST_Distance_Sphere with per-category radii and a running centroid, so repeat detections of one pothole merge into a single issue
JWT authentication with bcrypt hashing; signup restricted to whitelisted government employee IDs through a foreign key
SQL views for SLA tracking and recurring hotspots, plus an accident alert log that routes to the relevant departments
Ingest client buffers detections offline and replays them in order when connectivity returns

title: MobiSense Watershed Intelligence
category: Prototype · SIH 2026 PS SIH26015 · Ministry of Rural Development
summary: A prototype that turns geo-tagged field photographs into watershed insights: it reads GPS from EXIF metadata, maps each photo to its watershed boundary, and runs AI feature detection on the image.
highlights: FastAPI backend with 20+ REST endpoints; runs on MySQL 8.0 and falls back to SQLite automatically when MySQL is unavailable
Haversine distance, ray-casting point-in-polygon containment, and before/after change detection on vegetation and water indicators
OpenCV pipeline: Laplacian sharpness check, CLAHE contrast normalisation, HSV segmentation of vegetation, water and soil
8-page vanilla JavaScript dashboard with Google Maps polygons, a before/after slider and printable reports, backed by automated test scripts

title: Multi-Page Preschool Website
tagline: Responsive full-stack site with a protected admin route
summary: A five-page responsive website (Home, About, Academics, Gallery, Contact) taken from first HTML structure to a full responsive overhaul across mobile, tablet and desktop, with a Node.js backend behind it.
highlights: Node.js and Express backend with a MySQL database and a lead-capture API endpoint
Basic Auth-protected admin route for managing form submissions
Reusable shared header loaded with a JavaScript fetch-based include, removing duplicated markup across pages
